notes: Cited ref Akatsuka 1997 (DOI 10.1128/jb.179.15.4754-4760.1997, PMID 9244262) is about Serratia marcescens PrtA, NOT Photorhabdus; quote IS verbatim in that paper but it documents the S. marcescens protein, wrong organism for Photorhabdus laumondii TT01 Q7N8R3 (serralysin/plu0655; UniProt 'Secreted' by homology only, ECO:0000250). No direct P. entomophila secretion paper found; conserved-family cross-species citation acceptable but flagged.
